title: dispositions
description: Human-authored disposition decisions for a source-structure.json. Promotes the pilot run's paragraph-map schema verbatim (verdicts + shape), generalized from paragraph-only to every component kind. Target-agnostic: destinations are free-text; the WP/Drupal destination-prefix grammar is runtime-side (see README.md).

source_structure_hash.description: sha256 of the paired source-structure.json (canonical JSON: sorted keys, no extra whitespace). A mismatch means this file is stale relative to a regenerated inventory.

types.description: Keyed by component KEY (`{kind}:{id}`, matching a components[].key in the paired source-structure.json) -- NEVER by bare id. Verified against a live source: component ids are only unique WITHIN a kind (paragraphs_library_item and block_content share MySQL's auto-increment integer id space; a placement and a menu can share a machine name). One entry per inventoried component (Gate G1).

destination.description: Free-text, target-side destination expression. Grammar is runtime-side, not validated here. Use 'dropped' literally when this field is not migrated.

when.description: Free-text condition describing which instances of this component this branch applies to, e.g. 'field_price is non-empty'.

destinations.description: Required to be non-empty when verdict is not DROP and not DEFER (see the 'destinations required' rule enforced by validate_dispositions.py — a schema alone cannot express a conditional-required list in a way jsonschema draft-07 can evaluate cleanly across drafts, so this half of the rule is enforced in code, matching Gate G4's spirit one layer up from the runtime's own empty-destination check).

dropped_fields.description: Field machine names explicitly not carried forward, even though the component itself is not DROP.

fields.description: Per-field destination, keyed by field machine name.

pending_wiring.description: True when this row is dispositioned but the converter does not yet implement it. Distinguishes 'decided, not yet wired' from 'undispositioned' (Gate G1). Runtime treats this as a counted fallback in lab mode and rejects it under --strict; this contract only records the flag.
